notes.title: Punch to Glory Demo : Big Update
notes.content:
Well, after all this time, let's talk about what's been added to the game and what's changed.

[b][h1]Newly Added[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*]A short and sweet story explaining why our character is here, what his purpose is, and what happened to his father has been added.
[*]Interludes summarizing events in the form of a film strip were added.
[*]English voiceovers have been added to our main enemy, storytelling, and ring announcements.
[*]Fight Card Types added.
[*]Quest Types added.
[*]Effects have been added to enhance the fighting and make it feel more polished.
[/list]

[b][h1]What has Changed?[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*]Fighting Cards have completely changed, there is no longer just one type of card.
[*]Training will now do much more than just give exp for character development. Depending on the type of training, it will give card packs at every level.
[*]Training levels will increase automatically, so the more you do a specific workout, the more effective it will be.
[*]Fight cards will come out in packs.
[*]Card packs will be available for purchase, which means that money will have a new function.
[*]The character does not need to train to gain stats only, they can gain exp from every activity.
[/list]

I made a lot of changes and improvements that I can't even remember now. These are the things that come to mind right now, my friends. I hope you like them. Be sure to try out the demo.

notes.title: Punch to Glory - Demo Update v1
notes.content:
Greetings, let's take a look at what has changed, improved and fixed in this update.

[h1]Here are the Fixed Bugs :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed critical bug causing low fps on some systems.
[*] Fixed stress, hunger and stamina drain when entering the vehicle towing area.
[*] Fixed an issue with incorrect damage measurement in the Cards area.
[*] Fixed an issue where cards in the boxing ring were incorrectly measuring damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where the opponent's stamina in the boxing ring would go to a negative value.
[*] Fixed the issue where the opponent's dodging moves in the boxing ring would not reduce stamina.
[*] Fixed the issue where the inter-round effect would not end when the player and opponent were knockout.
[/list]

[h1]Here's What's New:[/h1]

[olist]
[*] A pass the round system has been added to the game for the enemy in the boxing ring and our character to recover stamina.

[*] In case of player and opponent knockout, it is now possible to beat the countdown by simply pressing space.

[*] It is now possible to press the S key to skip that round and gain 5% stamina.

[*] A system is now in place to alert you when there is a change in your inventory. In this way, I tried to provide a more understandable game structure.
[/olist]

[h1]Changing Things :[/h1]

Training time, training points, character points earned have been balanced.

Added icons in the boxing ring indicating that when you sense your opponent's action, they can attack, defend or dodge and hit you.

Quite a lot of quality of life improvements.

These are all the changes I can think of right now, I hope you like them.
Sincerely,
Musa GUNGOR
